   - Backend Developer
   - Quality Assurance Engineer
   - UI/UX Designer
5. Add up to 3 additional roles based on needs

7. Use Title Case for all roles

Build a task management web app for small teams. Team: 1 PM, 2 devs, 1 QA.
<<<END PROPOSAL>>>
